coordinate_and_order_contract.axis_scope: X=800 and Y=1200 are fixed nominal model spans, not invariant camera-dynamic front width/depth. Source +Z is anatomical deck side; camera coordinates use OpenCV +Z forward.
coordinate_and_order_contract.projection: X_camera = R_m2c X_model + t_m2c; homogeneous image = K X_camera, then divide by camera Z. Row-vector code implements points @ R.T + t.
coordinate_and_order_contract.camera_object: solve(R, -t), used in V153; exact linear inverse avoids silently treating rounded R as perfectly orthonormal.
coordinate_and_order_contract.front_choice: Maximum outward-normal cosine to camera from cuboid center, among four vertical faces only; top/bottom excluded.
coordinate_and_order_contract.top_bottom: V74 uses source world Z; V153 MR adaptation passes centered model coordinates, retaining model +Z deck anatomy for upright source objects. This is an explicit adaptation, not a recovered official MR native8 rule.
coordinate_and_order_contract.front_left_right: Front top endpoints sorted by projected image X; slots0/1 are left/right top and slots3/2 their vertical bottom partners.
coordinate_and_order_contract.rear: Slots4..7 continue front0..3 through opposite depth edges; rear is not independently image-X sorted. A rear point can lie on a visible adjacent side/top; rear name does not force S.
coordinate_and_order_contract.permutation_direction: dynamic[k] = fixed[perm[k]]; never reapply to already dynamic stored arrays.
coordinate_and_order_contract.ties: np.argmax/face list order in replay helper. Exact historical writer tie policy uncertified. Face-score and top-LR margins are evidence flags, not automatic semantic thresholds.
coordinate_and_order_contract.centroid: Separate projection of model center (0,0,0); index8 is outside native8 and is not the mean of eight 2D projections.
coordinate_and_order_contract.training_visibility_flag_caveat: prepare_yolo_pose.py writes v=2 for known in-padded-canvas coordinates; this transport flag is not native semantic D.
